title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Class, Packing Group and Lane at the Review Decision
content:
## Clause

When a Dangerous Goods Acceptance review is decided, the goods are measured against their category on the acceptance record exactly as it reads at that moment, including any change a signed amendment has made to it. Two of the measures concern the goods' classification and their route:

1. **Classification.** The IMDG class recorded on the acceptance appears on the category's list of classes, and the packing group recorded on it appears on the category's list of packing groups. Both must hold.
2. **Route.** The trade lane recorded on the acceptance is one of the lanes on which the category is carried.

## Input, judgement, output

| Acceptance shows | Test | Outcome of the test |
|---|---|---|
| a class the category lists, and a packing group the category lists | classification | passes |
| a class the category lists, and a packing group it does not list | classification | fails |
| a lane on the category's list | route | passes |
| a lane missing from the category's list | route | fails |

## Point of judgement

**An amendment changed the packing group after the application was admitted. Which packing group is tested?** The one the acceptance shows when the decision is taken.
